tests.scenario: Subscription Terms Explicitly Displayed Before Free-Trial
steps: Open the Calm app and navigate to the sign-up page
Proceed to the payment page
Look on the payment page for billing details
tests.expected_result: The exact billing details including amount, frequency, and relevant dates are clearly displayed on the payment page before confirmation of subscription.

steps: Open the Calm app and navigate to the sign-up page
Proceed to the payment page without clicking any additional dialogue
Check to see if billing details are visible by default where no user input is required to find them on the payment page.
tests.expected_result: Billing details are visible on default on the payment page without any user input

tests.scenario: No Automatic Subscription Sign-Up After Free Trial Period
steps: Sign-up for a free trial
Allow free trial period to end naturally
Check the users account for a subscription status
Sign-up for the free trial
Let the free trial end
Observe whether the system prompts the user to confirm a payment to continue services.
tests.expected_result: The system clearly presents the user with an explicit subscription prompt where the user must confirm before the subscription is paid.

steps: Sign-in to the Calm app
Navigate to the sleep audio
Count the total amount of distinct sleep audio tracks
tests.expected_result: The collection of sleep audio contains at least 50 distinct tracks.

tests.scenario: Availability to Wide Variety of Narrators and Environmental Sounds.
steps: Sign-in to the Calm app
Navigate to the sleep audio
Browse audio content to identify the variety of narrator voices and environmental sounds
tests.expected_result: The library includes sleep stories narrated by more than one narrators and at least 5 distinct environmental sound options.

tests.scenario: Sleep Audio Plays Un-Interrupted for 8 Consectuive Hours
steps: Sign-in to the Calm app
Start a sleep audio session
After 8 hours have passed, observe whether the audio is still playing
tests.expected_result: The application remains running after 8 hours, where the audio is not interrupted during the 8-hours.

tests.scenario: App Still Runs In-Background During a Sleep Session
steps: Sign-in to the Calm app
Start a sleep audio session
Lock the device and let audio play for 6-hours to see if the app does not crash or the audio is disrupted.

tests.scenario: Notifications Sent 30 Days Before Price Changes
steps: Set a date for a subscription price change in the system
Sign-in to the Calm app as a subscribed user
Check Calm for an in-app notification that discloses the the price change to the user
tests.expected_result: An in-app notification clearly displays to the user of a price change within 30 days of it.

tests.scenario: Email Notification Sent 30 Days Before a Price Change
steps: Set a date for a subscription price change in the system
Check the inbox of a user who is signed up with the Calm app to see if they've been notified 30 days before a pricing change is put into affect
tests.expected_result: An email is recieved by a subscribed user 30 days prior to a price change, where the email contains new subscription details including the new price and effective date.

tests.scenario: Free Tier Grants Core Feature Access
steps: Navigate to the payment page and select the free tier option
Navigate the app and try to access core mental wellness features
tests.expected_result: After selecting the free model, the user is granted access to core mental wellness features for the full billing period.

tests.scenario: Free Tier Model is Clearly Visible On Payment Page
steps: Open the Calm app and navigate to the payment page
Check to see if there is a free version of Calm available
tests.expected_result: A free or price-reduced subscription option for is visible for and selectable.

tests.scenario: Search by Narrator Name Displays Correct Results
steps: Sign-in to the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation content search bar
Enter a narrator's name into the search bar and see if the correct results are returned.
tests.expected_result: All the returned results are narrated by only the narrator that was searched for by the user.

tests.scenario: Narrator Search Returns Results Within 2 Seconds
steps: Sign-in to the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation content search bar and enter a narrator to search for
Record the time between sumitting the search request and how long until the results are returned
tests.expected_result: Search results are displayed after 2 seconds of submitting the request.
